decisions.reason: Removing Aave yield integration does not change the established automatic direct-wallet prize delivery flow.
The referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, and automatic wallet payout do not depend on Aave integration.
The FAQ state at this time contains no Aave or yield-generation claim requiring removal; its prize-pool funding copy remains valid unchanged.
The mission-page content does not claim Aave integration or prize-pool yield generation.
Removing Aave does not alter Chainlink VRF, ticket-weighted selection, or on-chain winner verification.
The Aave removal does not change the current or planned product names.
Removing an Aave integration does not change the requirement to use Base as the Ethereum L2 network.
The random allocation of a no-referral commission to an existing NFT holder is independent of Aave.
The NFT mint-number referral identity, sharing methods, and display surfaces are unaffected by removal of Aave.
The Transak provider, fiat-to-USDC conversion, payment methods, and deferred status do not rely on Aave integration.
NFT resale transfer of book entitlement, referral identity, badges, and ticket state remains valid without Aave.
Removing prize-pool yield generation does not entail changing the mint price, founder or commission shares, or allocations to the existing prize pools.
